cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Because I need help, not a second direction.

mechanism: A recruits a raffle helper under a deputy title while conceding real prize choices and visible credit to preserve B willingness without surrendering direction.
confusable: Unlike genuinely equal co-leadership, A still defines help as delegated service; unlike rigid hierarchy A negotiates powers to keep a deputy.
comparison: Raffle prize responsibility and public credit differ from picnic shopping orders and control over communication method.
seedUse: Use D49-a deputy badge/co-organizer dispute and S02-b adaptive captain logic. D49-a/b held canonical seeds are creative context only; S06+D49-b remains pending.
